name: GES Optimization Strategy
definition: An optimization approach for GES that controls shape density by selectively pruning splats based on shape attributes, eliminating the need for a variable density mechanism. It optimizes shape parameter $\beta$, position $x$, opacity $\kappa$, covariance $\Sigma$, and spherical harmonics coefficients using SGD.
summary: The GES Optimization Strategy trains Generalized Exponential Splatting by optimizing a shape parameter and using frequency-modulated loss to enhance high-frequency details while eliminating variable density mechanisms through shape-based pruning.
